sources.locator: "Treaty of Paris between Italy and the Allied Powers", revision 1373123064, § lead

explanation: The treaty’s article says what it settled: it “was signed on 10 February 1947, formally ending World War II hostilities between the parties” and “came into general effect on 15 September 1947”. A peace is a thing a war produces, and this atlas already reads the armistice of 22 June 1940 and the Japanese instrument of surrender the same way.
